The integral gain ki remains at 0.5 to preserve integral action, and sensor weights and line loss strategy remain unchanged as no issues were reported with them. This candidate is a reasonable refinement based on prior evidence but has not yet been tested in a race. Depending on the next race results, if steering oscillations persist, consider further increasing kd or slightly lowering kp; if progress is low but stable, cautiously increase base speed further; if line loss events occur, consider adjusting sensor weights or line loss strategy.
